title: Event Envelope
description: Canonical envelope wrapping every callback and internal event emitted by the runtime, independent of provider-specific payload shape.

eventId.description: Unique id for this event. Stable across redelivery attempts of the same logical event (duplicateCallback re-sends the same eventId).

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the underlying state change occurred.

providerId.description: Provider id this event belongs to, e.g. tz-mpesa.

correlationId.description: Id of the canonical payment/transaction this event relates to.

requestId.description: Id of the originating request, if this event was triggered by one.

attempt.description: 1-based delivery attempt number for this eventId.

signature.description: HMAC signature of the payload, present on delivered callbacks. See SECURITY.md for signature verification guidance.

data.description: Canonical event body. Provider plugins map this into their provider-specific callback payload shape.
